risks.risk: Glass condition uncertainty: possible chips, cracks, or edge damage that affects safety and usability.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up video/series of photos of all 4 edges and all corners (front/back), taken under bright light, plus a straight-on shot showing the full surface for hairline cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as damaged/unsafe until proven otherwise (i.e., treated like it may need replacement or careful handling).

risks.risk: Size/fit uncertainty: without dimensions, you can’t confirm whether it matches your intended space or whether it’s a standard tabletop size.
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo showing length x width (and thickness if possible) with the glass placed flat.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case for unknown size (assume smaller/less valuable and no matching base).

risks.risk: Mounting/compatibility uncertainty: the corner hardware may not match common table frames/legs, and you may need custom legs.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the underside and the exact mounting points/holes (and whether there are threaded inserts or just holes).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring new/custom legs (legs not included already).

proof_requests: Close-up photos/videos of all edges and corners (front and back) under bright light to confirm no chips/cracks.
A tape-measure photo showing exact length x width (and thickness if possible).
Underside photo showing mounting points/holes and how legs would attach.
response.reason: With only one photo and no dimensions or clear edge-condition proof, the key factors that determine value (size and whether the glass is chipped/cracked) are unverified. A worst-case price can’t be confidently set without those decisive checks.
